description: An expander that puts Purfenator's menu settings under CV control; it goes immediately beside Purfenator on either side, and one to its right takes precedence

inputs.text: Polyphonic CV for the title settings, one per channel: module active, draw button, button position, draw, flip and bright title, font size, red, green, blue and alpha; eleven, not the tooltip's eight
Polyphonic CV for the colour background, one per channel: draw background, gradient, four colour values, four gradient values, gradient start and end, radial x and y, box radius and range
Polyphonic CV for the image background, one per channel: draw background, image on top of colour, tiled, ignore zoom, scale, image position, width and height offsets, then x and y offsets
Polyphonic CV for the skiff, one per channel: draw skiff, bezel, rails and shadow, skiff depth, bezel size, shadow size, softness and intensity, three skiff colours, four inside colours
Polyphonic CV for the multimode settings, one per channel: multimode, split vertically, and the horizontal threshold

notes: an on-off setting expects a trigger, and any signal above 0V flips it; a numeric setting takes 0-10V across its range, and 0V leaves it where it was
CV changes a setting directly, with no attenuvertor and no offset, and those changes cannot be undone
the module changes nothing by itself: it needs a Purfenator beside it, and that Purfenator has to be active for any of this to show
menu: Poly inputs channel map: lists, for each of the five inputs, which polyphonic channel carries which Purfenator setting
